description: React component for Multi-factor Authentication (MFA) control, handling MFA setup and confirmation routes, UI rendering, and logout functionality.

classes.name: MFAController
classes.description: React component managing MFA setup and confirmation, including UI rendering and logout handling.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds CSS classes to document body and root element; redirects if MFA is disabled.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Removes CSS classes from document body and root element.

methods.name: handleOnClick
methods.description: Handles logout button click, triggers user logout event.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders MFA setup UI, including conditional logout button, logo, and nested routes for setup and confirm.
